planSteps.description: Verify the quiz shows the label 'BAHASA INDONESIA · BAB 03' and exactly 5 questions with radio options
Answer each of the 5 questions by selecting one radio option per question (the submit button stays disabled until all 5 are answered)
Click the button 'Kirim jawaban' and wait for the result page to load
Verify the URL becomes /siswa/latihan/hasil and the page displays a score number plus the line 'Jawaban benar: X dari 5 soal'
